verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no first-party data export or account-exit feature. There is a JSON API, and the MCP server can pull messages, call history and contacts. Those are developer building blocks a user could use to build their own export, not a documented 'export all data in open formats' capability. The only porting mention covers bringing a number in, not taking data out.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
